about_the_game:
My Place Diary is a casual simulation game where you can decorate your dream space in a pixelated art style.

If you want to turn an ordinary space into your own special hideout, jump into the game now!

Two Ways to Enjoy the Game

'My Place Diary' offers two special modes:

Free Stage: There are no rules or missions here. Arrange your space and place items as you wish, using your imagination to create your perfect space!

Themed Stage: This is a mission-based mode where you decorate a room according to a specific concept. Try decorating spaces with a variety of themes!

A Unique Experience Decorating Your Own Space

Placing items is very simple. Just click the number key of the item you want in the inventory and click on the space with your mouse to place it. If you want to change the item's direction, you can click on it and press the Q or R key to rotate it by 15 degrees. After placing all the items, a 'Stage Clear' screen will appear, where you can choose to keep decorating the space or move on to the next stage.

Unleash your creativity in 'My Place Diary' and complete a unique space that's one of a kind!
